gaps.explanation: Jail Bond Fund: the p6 schedule prints Total Receipts 830,069 (and Total Disbursements 2,433,884 including Operating Expense 113), while the p3 statement Jail Bond column prints Total Receipts 829,956 and Disbursements 2,433,771 (net of the 113; same net change). Schedule 51,311,446 - statement 51,311,333 = 113. Both printed; no fix.

Gap 58,963 = 59,076 - 113. (1) Nonmajor funds: the combining schedule p9-10 prints Sick & Vacation 'Interfund Transfers' 59,076 among disbursements (Total Nonmajor Interfund Transfers 671,908, Total Disbursements 4,321,662, p10), so detail records it as a transfer out; the p3 statement counts it as spending (Other Governmental Funds disbursements 3,708,830 = 4,321,662 - 671,908 + 59,076; Transfers Out 612,832 = 671,908 - 59,076). (2) Jail Bond: schedule p6 includes Operating Expense 113 that the p3 statement nets (2,433,884 vs 2,433,771). Statement 52,169,161 - schedule 52,110,198 = 59,076 - 113 = 58,963. Printed differently in the report; no fix.

Schedule 4,549,149 is above the statement 4,518,073 (p3) by 31,076 = 59,076 - 28,000. (1) Nonmajor combining schedule p10 prints transfers out 671,908 (incl. Sick & Vacation 59,076) vs p3 Other Governmental Funds Transfers Out 612,832 (the statement counts the 59,076 as spending). (2) The General Fund department schedule p11 prints Interfund Transfers 1,785,192 while the p3 statement (and the p5 budget schedule) print General Fund Transfers Out 1,813,192 (28,000 more). Both printed as such; no fix.
